proof.text: For each system M, let a be the evaluated system unit followed by the displayed direct-evaluation comparison. The two normalization equations say a followed by direct image of either comparison is the finite adjunction unit. Postcompose each equation with the direct image of its comparison inverse: functoriality and inverse cancellation show that both inverses have adjoint transpose a. Injectivity of the finite adjunction hom-equivalence makes the inverses equal. Inverting again gives equality of the component isomorphisms, and extensionality of natural transformations gives equality of the natural isomorphisms.
